purpose.zh: 练下背和臀部，提升背部耐力
purpose.en: Build the lower back and glutes and improve back endurance.

text.zh: 髋压在球上，抬到身体一条直线即可
text.en: With hips on the ball, lift only until your body forms a straight line
Brace your feet against the wall with legs straight.

text.zh: 顶端停一秒，再慢慢放下
text.en: Pause for a second at the top, then lower slowly.

commonErrors.en: Lifting too high and overarching the lower back.

cautions.zh: 腰部不适时减小幅度，仍痛就停止
cautions.en: Reduce the range if your lower back feels uncomfortable, and stop if it still hurts.
